q.en: At 10% simple interest, how many years until a sum becomes 2 times itself?
q.as: 10% সৰল সুতত ধন 2 গুণ হ'বলৈ কিমান বছৰ লাগিব?

why.en: The interest must be 1 times the sum: 100% ÷ 10.
why.as: সুত ধনৰ 1 গুণ হ'ব লাগিব: 100% ÷ 10।

why.en: 2 times the sum is the amount. The sum itself is already there, so the interest is only 1 times.
why.as: 2 গুণ হৈছে সমূল ধন। মূল ধন আগতেই আছে, সেয়ে সুত 1 গুণহে।

q.en: A sum amounts to ₹1120 in 2 years and ₹1300 in 5 years at simple interest. Find the sum.
q.as: এটা ধন সৰল সুতত 2 বছৰত ₹1120 আৰু 5 বছৰত ₹1300 হয়। ধনটো উলিওৱা।

note.en: Later amount less earlier amount.
Divide by 3, the gap in years.
Take 2 years' interest off the 2-year amount.
note.as: 2 বছৰৰ সমূল ধনৰ পৰা 2 বছৰৰ সুত বাদ দিয়া।
